review_method: Read all85 complete actual Ruth source units in one full-book display and every complete retained target and necessary immediate context. Separately displayed and reread all90 complete source/target/category/rationale triples in four untruncated chapter groups, then reread all five complete author-narrowed triples before freeze. Additional contexts read include Genesis12:1–10/35:23–26/38:24–30/46:12, Judges2:16–18, Leviticus19:9–10/23:22/25:25, Deuteronomy24:19–22/25:5–10, Psalms90:1–4, Numbers1:1–7, Matthew1:3–6 and1Samuel3:16–18. Links concern particular request/response or instruction/performance pairs, repeated household-rest and emptiness themes, named family/property connections, explicit laws with retained scope differences, actual wing and strength imagery, speaker distinctions and supported genealogical clauses. Every same-chapter relation is explicitly labelled. No exhaustive discovery, source-language/apparatus, independent specialist, exact legal equivalence, modern site or unresolved individual-name identity verification is claimed. Before final peer binding, reread one further complete4:19/4:18 triple replacing another-edition wording with different supplied name form. This keeps the candidate comparison within the same Saints edition. Exact previous frozen input and author receipt preserved; all89 other rows unchanged and zero additional credit.
